text:
mira: quick heads-up — perf regression seen on canary vs main for long-prefill workloads, p95 up ~18%
kevin: ugh. is this prefill or decode heavy?
mira: breakdown shows most time in prefill kernel selection and slower matmul path during long sequences
jia: do we have a flamegraph/trace?
mira: uploaded a short profile: 
```
prefill: 68ms (kern: matmul_opt_v2 45ms, kv_cpy 12ms, other 11ms)
decode: 18ms (kern: attn_fast 10ms, softmax 4ms, sampling 4ms)
```
kevin: matmul_opt_v2 spike — that kernel got a change in 177f9b8 (fused-bias tweak)
jia: could be kernel selection heuristic choosing matmul_opt_v2 for long seqs vs matmul_opt_v1 for short, maybe threshold wrong
sam: also saw microbatching increase p95 when we up batch_size for throughput; tail spikes align with KV eviction/fallbacks on prefill
olga: +1 on KV eviction. the kv cache debug logs show intermittent misses around 2k tokens which trigger a slow path: 
```
KV_MISS idx=2048 -> fallback_copy
```
mira: idea: split the decision point — force matmul_opt_v1 for prefill, keep matmul_opt_v2 for decode, compare cost/latency
kevin: we can add a per-stage kernel override flag in runtime config (experimental) and run canary tests
jia: also want per-token timing metrics surfaced in console: prefill_total, prefill_per_token, decode_total, decode_per_token so we can see regressions quickly
sam: experiments we should run: 
- baseline (main)
- force-opt-v1-prefill
- reduce_microbatch_size to 4
- increase_kv_cache_capacity on canary
Collect p50/p95/p99 and tail traces
kevin: agree. hypothesis: throughput->batching heuristics are tipping kernel selection thresholds because sequence-length distribution changed recently (new eval prompts)
olga: noted a related log pattern: when kv cache copy path triggers, decode latency is fine but prefill gets the hit (prefix copy cost)
mira: assign: kevin -> add kernel_override flag + variant tests; jia -> add per-stage metrics + dashboard panel; sam -> run microbatch sizing sweep and kv cache capacity test; olga -> add debug hooks to kv copy path for canary
kevin: I'll open a PR for the config flag and a canary job by EOD
jia: I'll sketch the dashboard tiles and add an alert for prefill_per_token > 0.06ms/token at p95
sam: running sweep now, will post results in this thread
deploy-bot: rollout to canary group "runtime-prefill-split" completed at 1802001300
mira: thanks — if canary shows improvement we'll consider safe rollback of the fused-bias tweak or keep it but gate it behind new heuristic
kevin: update: initial canary (force-opt-v1-prefill) dropped prefill p95 from 68ms -> 41ms, overall p99 improved ~12%
jia: good sign. still want to validate throughput impact (tokens/s)
sam: microbatch size 4 reduced p99 by 9% but throughput down 15% on dedicated GPUs
olga: KV capacity bump removed the copy fallback in 98% of traces for our test prompts
mira: next steps: merge metrics PR, schedule canary with kernel_override off by default but accessible; sync in next runtime standup if no surprises
kevin: filing follow-ups now: PERF-1023 (kernel heuristic tweak), PERF-1024 (metrics), PERF-1025 (kv debug hooks)
mira: awesome — thanks team :thumbsup:
